annotations.title: Submit a Grok Bot to the directory

description: Submit your own public Grok Bot share link for a free, human-reviewed listing. Only for a Bot the user built or has permission to share. The share link is checked live on x.ai and the listing is credited to the creator. Returns status queued, already_queued, listed, invalid or not_found, plus optional paid upgrades. Free; never call start_checkout unless the user asks.

category.description: Directory category that fits the Bot best.

credit.description: Optional name or @handle to credit if the share page shows only a first name.

origin.description: Optional https:// link to the post that announced the Bot.

shareUrl.description: Public share link from Grok Bot's Copy share link, e.g. https://x.ai/bot/abc123.

summary.description: Optional one plain line about what it does, in the user's words.

name: submit_bot
title: Submit a Grok Bot to the directory
